name: In-process background work
summary: Deliberately minimal. Adequate for email sending and light async work. Any client with meaningful volume, long-running work, or a need for retry guarantees requires the ops.queue upgrade. Validation warns when a capability declaring performs_async_work runs on kernel work, and errors for docs.extraction, automation.rules, and every integration capability.

requires.reason: Job lifecycle is published onto the bus.

owns.name: Job
owns.description: In-process job record. No durable retry, no dead-letter, no cross-process concurrency control — that is what ops.queue adds.

exposes.name: enqueue
exposes.description: ops.queue must satisfy this signature to upgrade this capability.

smoke.name: enqueued work runs
smoke.asserts: an enqueued job executes and its completion is observable

templates.description: Job registrations collected from the resolved graph.
